title: Knockout Crispy German Pork Skewers
description: A rich and crispy German dish featuring gorgonzola-dolce, perfect for adventurous eaters, this paleo-friendly recipe is a knockout at any dinner party.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together coconut aminos, apple cider vinegar, black pepper, garlic powder, and onion powder.
Add the pork cubes to the bowl and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
In a separate bowl, mix together crushed pork rinds and chopped parsley.
Remove the pork from the marinade and dip each cube into the beaten egg, then roll in the pork rind mixture to coat.
Thread the coated pork cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 20 minutes.
While the pork is baking, crumble the gorgonzola-dolce into a bowl.
After 20 minutes, remove the skewers from the oven and top each piece of pork with a small amount of crumbled gorgonzola-dolce.
Return the skewers to the oven and bake for an additional 5 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and the pork is crispy.
